system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you would take damage while your Chakra Barrier has 0 Hit points, you can spend a superiority die. It remains a number of hit points equal to 3 times the result, until the end of the current turn, returning back to 0 hit points.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

roll.note: Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized (only the subclass that lists it can take it). Taking damage while your Chakra Barrier has 0 hit points: it has 3 × the die hit points until the end of the turn.
